note: Seed data for the ModelPulse Fedo demo board. Status values match FedoKit raw values: in_review, planned, in_progress, done, closed (closed = declined).

feedbacks.title: Search models by name
feedbacks.description: With 400+ models in the list it takes forever to scroll to the one I want. A search bar that matches model names (and ideally the model ID like anthropic/claude-opus-5) would make the app much faster to use.

comments.author: Lina K.
comments.body: Yes please, I mostly look up the same 3-4 models every day.

comments.author: ModelPulse team
comments.body: Shipped in 0.3.0. Search matches both the display name and the model ID.

feedbacks.title: Filter by provider
feedbacks.description: I only care about a couple of providers. A way to show just Anthropic, OpenAI or Google models (with a count per provider) would cut the noise a lot.

comments.author: Omar H.
comments.body: Also useful to see how many models each provider has at a glance.

comments.author: ModelPulse team
comments.body: Shipped in 0.3.0: tap the filter icon on the Latest Models screen. Counts are shown next to each provider.

feedbacks.title: Dark mode
feedbacks.description: I check new releases at night and the bright white list is painful. Please support the system dark appearance.

comments.author: ModelPulse team
comments.body: Done. The app follows your system appearance setting.

feedbacks.title: Compare two models side by side
feedbacks.description: When a new model drops I want to compare it with the one I use today: input/output price per 1M tokens, context length and input modalities in two columns. Picking models from the list and tapping Compare would be ideal.

comments.author: Sara M.
comments.body: This is the #1 thing I'm missing. Even just price and context would be enough for a first version.

comments.author: Dev P.
comments.body: Would love a 'cheaper alternative' hint too, but compare alone is great.

comments.author: ModelPulse team
comments.body: We're building this now. First version compares pricing, context length and modalities for two models.

feedbacks.title: Save favorite models
feedbacks.description: Let me star models so they show up in a Favorites section at the top of the list. Right now I search for the same models every time I open the app.

comments.author: Jonas W.
comments.body: Syncing favorites across devices would be a bonus.

comments.author: ModelPulse team
comments.body: In progress. Favorites will be stored on device first; sync may come later.

feedbacks.title: Price drop alerts
feedbacks.description: Notify me when a model I follow gets cheaper (input or output price per 1M tokens). Providers change prices often and I only notice weeks later.

comments.author: Priya S.
comments.body: A weekly digest would work for me too, doesn't have to be instant.

comments.author: ModelPulse team
comments.body: Reviewing this. Alerts need background refresh and notifications, so we're checking how reliable that can be on iOS.

feedbacks.title: Sort by price or context length
feedbacks.description: Newest first is great for discovery, but sometimes I want the cheapest models or the largest context window first. A sort option next to the provider filter would help.

comments.author: Marco R.
comments.body: Sorting by output price matters more to me than input price.

feedbacks.title: Show benchmark scores
feedbacks.description: Pricing and context are useful, but I'd like to see a couple of well-known benchmark scores on the detail screen so I can judge quality, not just cost.

comments.author: ModelPulse team
comments.body: Looking into data sources. OpenRouter's models API doesn't include benchmarks, so we'd need a second source we can trust and credit.

feedbacks.title: Chat with a model inside the app
feedbacks.description: Add a playground where I can send a prompt to any model from the detail screen and see the response.

comments.author: Ali T.
comments.body: Would be handy for quick tests.

comments.author: ModelPulse team
comments.body: Declined for now. Running prompts needs API keys and paid usage per provider, which is outside what ModelPulse is for: tracking and comparing models. The detail screen links you to the model ID so you can try it in your own tools.

feedbacks.title: Android version
feedbacks.description: Our team is split between iPhone and Android. Please release ModelPulse for Android too.

comments.author: ModelPulse team
comments.body: Declined. ModelPulse is the iOS example app for the Fedo SDK, so it stays iOS-only. Fedo also has an Android SDK if you want to build something similar.
